security_spec.violation_condition: QEMU TCG or KVM CSR write handler for mip/mie does not apply WARL masking to clear writable bits that are not implemented (e.g., reserved interrupt sources, platform-specific bits). A guest writes an illegal bit pattern to mip/mie, and the value reads back with unimplemented bits set instead of being masked to legal values.
security_spec.summary: mip/mie CSR write paths must enforce WARL masking to prevent guests from setting unimplemented interrupt bits and reading them back, leaking the fact that QEMU does not implement certain interrupt sources.
